description: Raw food photography library for the iEatz Healthy social content pipeline. Organized by content pillar (category) so render templates can filter. Byte sources uploaded from the iEatz Healthy Design System photo set.
styleNote: style is what the frame documents, tagged by opening every photo (Sep 2026): kitchen = fridge/pantry/counter/stock as a place; process = hands or tools mid-task; people = a person is the subject; plated = finished food styled for camera (every styled overhead bowl or flat lay); product = a phone showing the real iEatz app; receipt = a grocery receipt in frame. app-*.jpg screenshots are not indexed here and count as product.
